title: Launch Complications
description: Technical issues discovered day before product launch
initialPrompt: Критический баг обнаружен! Система падает под нагрузкой. Запуск завтра. Что делаем?
systemPrompt: You are technical lead with crisis. Bug is serious but fixable with all-nighter. Or delay launch. Need decision and action plan. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User made decision and developed action plan.
hints: Можно исправить за ночь? (Can it be fixed overnight?)
Какие риски при запуске с багом? (What are the risks launching with the bug?)
Возможна ли задержка? (Is a delay possible?)
